解析:
（方法一） 本题有较多的0，可考虑直接用行(列)展开公式，例如按第一行展开

$$
\begin{array}{r l} & {\left| \begin{array}{l l l l} 0 & a & b & 0 \\ a & 0 & 0 & b \\ 0 & c & d & 0 \\ c & 0 & 0 & d \end{array} \right| = - a \left| \begin{array}{l l l} a & 0 & b \\ 0 & d & 0 \\ c & 0 & d \end{array} \right| + b \left| \begin{array}{l l l} a & 0 & b \\ 0 & c & 0 \\ c & 0 & d \end{array} \right|} \\ & {\qquad = - a d \left| \begin{array}{l l} a & b \\ c & d \end{array} \right| + b c \left| \begin{array}{l l} a & b \\ c & d \end{array} \right| = (a d - b c) (- a d + b c)} \\ & {\qquad = - (a d - b c) ^ {2}.} \end{array}
$$

(方法二) 本题0的位置很规则,也可联想到用拉普拉斯展开式.

$$
\begin{array}{r l} & {\left| \begin{array}{c c c c} 0 & a & b & 0 \\ a & 0 & 0 & b \\ 0 & c & d & 0 \\ c & 0 & 0 & d \end{array} \right| = - \left| \begin{array}{c c c c} c & 0 & 0 & d \\ a & 0 & 0 & b \\ 0 & c & d & 0 \\ 0 & a & b & 0 \end{array} \right| = \left| \begin{array}{c c c c} c & d & 0 & 0 \\ a & b & 0 & 0 \\ 0 & 0 & d & c \\ 0 & 0 & b & a \end{array} \right|} \\ & {\qquad = \left| \begin{array}{c c} c & d \\ a & b \end{array} \right| \cdot \left| \begin{array}{c c} d & c \\ b & a \end{array} \right| = - (a d - b c) ^ {2}.} \end{array}
$$

解析:
（方法一） 每列都加到第1列，提出公因数

$$
D _ {n} = \left(\sum_ {i = 1} ^ {n} a _ {i} + b\right) \left| \begin{array}{c c c c c} 1 & a _ {2} & a _ {3} & \dots & a _ {n} \\ 1 & a _ {2} + b & a _ {3} & \dots & a _ {n} \\ 1 & a _ {2} & a _ {3} + b & \dots & a _ {n} \\ \vdots & \vdots & \vdots & & \vdots \\ 1 & a _ {2} & a _ {3} & \dots & a _ {n} + b \end{array} \right|
$$

$$
= \left(\sum_ {i = 1} ^ {n} a _ {i} + b\right) \left| \begin{array}{c c c c c} 1 & a _ {2} & a _ {3} & \dots & a _ {n} \\ 0 & b & 0 & \dots & 0 \\ 0 & 0 & b & \dots & 0 \\ \vdots & \vdots & \vdots & & \vdots \\ 0 & 0 & 0 & \dots & b \end{array} \right|
$$

$$
= \left(\sum_ {i = 1} ^ {n} a _ {i} + b\right) b ^ {n - 1}.
$$

对于这 $2^{n}$ 个行列式，有2个（或2个以上）第1子列则其值为0，不为0的共 $n + 1$ 个，即每列都是第2子列有1个，只有1列选第1子列，其余为第2子列，共 $n$ 个，故 $D_{n} = b^{n} + \sum_{i = 1}^{n}a_{i}b^{n - 1}$

题目内容: 【例1.14】设 A, B 为三阶矩阵，且 $\left|A\right|=3,\left|B\right|=2,\left|A+B\right|=a$ ，则 $\left|A^{-1}+B^{-1}\right|=$ ____.
解析:
由于 $\left|A+B\right|$ 没有运算法则, 利用 E 作恒等变形是常用技巧.

$$
\begin{array}{r l} \mid A ^ {- 1} + B ^ {- 1} \mid & = \mid E A ^ {- 1} + B ^ {- 1} E \mid \\ & = \mid (B ^ {- 1} B) A ^ {- 1} + B ^ {- 1} (A A ^ {- 1}) \mid = \mid B ^ {- 1} (B + A) A ^ {- 1} \mid \\ & = \mid B ^ {- 1} \mid \cdot \mid B + A \mid \cdot \mid A ^ {- 1} \mid = \frac {a}{6}. \end{array}
$$

$$
解析:
这是 $\lambda$ 的三次方程, 对于三次方程尽量用因式分解法求其根.

$$
\begin{array}{r l} \left| \begin{array}{c c c} \lambda - 3 & 1 & - 1 \\ 1 & \lambda - 5 & 1 \\ - 1 & 1 & \lambda - 3 \end{array} \right| & = \left| \begin{array}{c c c} \lambda - 2 & 0 & 2 - \lambda \\ 1 & \lambda - 5 & 1 \\ - 1 & 1 & \lambda - 3 \end{array} \right| \\ & = \left| \begin{array}{c c c} \lambda - 2 & 0 & 0 \\ 1 & \lambda - 5 & 2 \\ - 1 & 1 & \lambda - 4 \end{array} \right| \\ & = (\lambda - 2) \left| \begin{array}{c c} \lambda - 5 & 2 \\ 1 & \lambda - 4 \end{array} \right| \\ & = (\lambda - 2) (\lambda - 3) (\lambda - 6), \end{array}
$$

所以 $\lambda$ 为2或3或6.

本题的解法很多,例如

$$
\begin{array}{r l} \left| \begin{array}{c c c} \lambda - 3 & 1 & - 1 \\ 1 & \lambda - 5 & 1 \\ - 1 & 1 & \lambda - 3 \end{array} \right| & = \left| \begin{array}{c c c} \lambda - 3 & \lambda - 3 & \lambda - 3 \\ 1 & \lambda - 5 & 1 \\ - 1 & 1 & \lambda - 3 \end{array} \right| \\ & = \left| \begin{array}{c c c} \lambda - 3 & 0 & 0 \\ 1 & \lambda - 6 & 0 \\ - 1 & 2 & \lambda - 2 \end{array} \right| \\ & = (\lambda - 3) (\lambda - 6) (\lambda - 2). \end{array}
$$
